# RangeSelectController

> Enables contiguous range selection via drag or click, dispatching `ui-range-change` and `ui-range-select`.

## Constructor

```ts
new RangeSelectController(host: HTMLElement, options?: RangeSelectOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | yes |  |
| `mode` | `'drag' | 'click'` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-range-change` | `{ startIndex, endIndex, items, hi + 1) }` |
| `ui-range-select` | `{ startIndex, endIndex, items, hi + 1) }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |
| `clearRange()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { RangeSelectController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new RangeSelectController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
